sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(f,c):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
# Check N bar position (timer)
print('N bar:',pos(current_frame,'N'))
print('b:',pos(current_frame,'b'),' M:',pos(current_frame,'M'))
# Move platform DOWN to find bottom limit
for i in range(10):
    before = pos(current_frame,'b')
    action(['DOWN'])
    after = pos(current_frame,'b')
    if before == after:
        print(f'DOWN#{i+1}: stuck at {after}')
        break
    print(f'DOWN#{i+1}: {before} -> {after}')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def pos(f,c):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==c:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
# Check N bar position (timer)
print('N bar:',pos(current_frame,'N'))
print('b:',pos(current_frame,'b'),' M:',pos(current_frame,'M'))
# Move platform DOWN to find bottom limit
for i in range(10):
    before = pos(current_frame,'b')
    action(['DOWN'])
    after = pos(current_frame,'b')
    if before == after:
        print(f'DOWN#{i+1}: stuck at {after}')
        break
    print(f'DOWN#{i+1}: {before} -> {after}')
